editorial:
Imagine you are a space trucker just trying to make a living in a galaxy where big companies run everything. You meet John Canyon, a gritty guy who takes a shady job hauling mysterious crates to Earth because he is desperate for cash. The whole vibe feels like a futuristic road trip movie, but instead of a highway, you have the void of space. It is a fun, messy ride with a crew that feels like a group of misfits just trying to survive their own bad decisions. You will love the grimy look of the ship and the way the story kicks off with a bang.

The action really picks up once the killer robots break out of their boxes. While the special effects look a bit dated now, the pacing keeps you on your toes and the humor lands well. Some parts feel a bit slow, but the chaos makes up for it. If you enjoy cheesy 90s sci-fi, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection, but renting it on Apple TV is a quick way to see if you like it. It is a perfect pick for a lazy Friday night.
endingExplained: After a wild fight with the robot army, John and his crew manage to outsmart the machines. They use the ship's systems to trap the robots and blow them up, saving Earth from a mechanical invasion. In the end, John survives the chaos and learns that taking the easy money is never worth the risk. The movie wraps up with the crew safe and sound, though they are definitely exhausted from the madness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro sci-fi and robots.
